NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
1. TURKIYE REQUESTED THE GREEK AIS TO PROMULGATE APPROPRIATE NOTAM 
FOR THE EXERCISE AREA LOCATED WITHIN INTERNATIONAL WATERS AND 
AIRSPACE OF AEGEAN SEA REGARDING THE TURKISH NAVY AND AIRFORCE 
FIRING MILITARY EXERCISE (ASFAO) TO BE CONDUCTED FROM 20 MAY TILL 
31 DEC 2026 0500-1600UTC (EXCEPT SATURDAYS, SUNDAYS, HOLIDAYS) WITH 
REF 250826 LTAAYNYX DEC 2025.
GREEK AIS DID NOT PROMULGATE APPROPRIATE NOTAM FOR THE EXERCISE
AREA IN ACCORDANCE WITH OUR REF 250826 DEC 2025. UNDER THESE 
CIRCUMSTANCES DUE TO THE INSISTENT ATTITUDE OF GREECE, TURKIYE IS 
LEFT WITH NO OTHER ALTERNATIVE BUT TO TAKE ITS OWN INITATIVE TO 
PROMULGATE THE NECESSARY NOTAM FOR THE EXERCISE AREA.
TURKIYE WILL TAKE NECESSARY MEASURES FOR THE SAFETY OF THE GENERAL
AIR TRAFFIC AS SHE DID IN THE PAST AND IS ALWAYS READY FOR 
COOPERATION AND COORDINATION IN THIS RESPECT.
2. THE NOTAM INFORMATION FOR THE EXERCISE AREA IS AS FOLLOWED.
TURKISH NAVY AND AIRFORCE SHALL MAKE 'ASFAO' EXERCISE IN

properties.name: A4162/26 / LRBB
properties.originalText:
FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS
   MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION - ROMANIAN
   AIR OPERATORS AND OWNERS OF AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN ROMANIA SHALL
   NOT ENTER FIR KYIV (UKBU), FIR LVIV (UKLV), FIR KYIV (UKBV),
   FIR DNIPROPETROVSK (UKDV), FIR SIMFEROPOL (UKFV), FIR ODESA
   (UKOV), FIR ROSTOV-NA-DONU (URRV).
   SAID OPERATORS AND AICRAFT OWNERS SHALL ALSO AVOID FLIGHT 
   OPERATIONS WITHIN THE BUFFER ZONE EXTENDING OUT TO 200NM ALONG
   THE UKRAINE/RUSSIA BORDER.
   OPERATIONS WITHIN THE FIR CHISINAU (LUUU) AIRSPACE SHALL ONLY
   BE UNDERTAKEN IN COMPLIANCE WITH APPLICABLE AERONAUTICAL
   PUBLICATIONS ISSUED BY REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA.
   OPERATORS ARE REMINDED THAT OPERATIONS WITHIN FIR MINSK (UMMV)
   ARE PROHIBITED IN ACCORDANCE WITH EASA SAFETY DIRECTIVES
   SD-2021-02 AND SD-2021-03.
   ADDITIONAL RISK ASSESSMENT AND FLIGHT PLANNING DECISIONS SHALL
   BE TAKEN BEFORE OPERATING IN THE FOLLOWING AIRSPACE: 
   MOSCOW (UUWV)

UKRAINIAN CRISIS:
MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION.
CROATIAN AIR OPERATORS AND OWNERS OF AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN CROATIA
SHALL NOT ENTER UIR KYIV (UKBU), FIR LVIV (UKLV), FIR KYIV (UKBV),
FIR DNIPROPETROVSK (UKDV), FIR SIMFEROPOL (UKFV), FIR ODESA (UKOV),
FIR ROSTOV-ON-DON (URRV).
SAID OPERATORS AND AIRCRAFT OWNERS SHALL ALSO AVOID FLIGHT 
OPERATIONS WITHIN THE BUFFER ZONE EXTENDING OUT TO 200NM ALONG THE 
UKRAINE/RUSSIA BORDER. OPERATIONS WITHIN THE FIR CHISINAU (LUUU) 
AIRSPACE SHALL ONLY BE UNDERTAKEN IN COMPLIANCE WITH APPLICABLE 
AERONAUTICAL PUBLICATIONS ISSUED BY REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA.
OPERATORS ARE REMINDED THAT OPERATIONS WITHIN FIR MINSK (UMMV) ARE 
PROHIBITED IN ACCORDANCE WITH EASA SAFETY DIRECTIVES SD-2021-02 AND 
SD-2021-03.
ADDITIONAL RISK ASSESSMENT AND FLIGHT PLANNING DECISIONS SHALL BE 
TAKEN BEFORE OPERATING IN THE FOLLOWING AIRSPACE: MOSCOW (UUWV).

properties.originalText:
ASCENT OF FREE BALLOON WILL TAKE PLACE WITHIN LTB7 (DOGUBAYAZIT):
393445N0440824E 393951N0440822E 393943N0435003E 393456N0435002E 
393445N0440824E
REMARKS:
 - TURKIYE AIP VFR FLIGHT RULES AND AIP REGULATIONS SHALL BE 
COMPLIED 
WITH.
- CONDITIONS TO BE OBSERVED: 
A. THE REGION IS FREQUENTLY USED BY TURKISH ARMED FORCES HELICOPTERS 
FLYING UNDER VISUAL FLIGHT RULES, PARTICULARLY AT LOW ALTITUDES, AS 
WELL AS BY UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLES CONDUCTING SURVEILLANCE MISSIONS 
AT HIGHER ALTITUDES,
B. GIVEN THE REGIONS PROXIMITY TO THE BORDER, FLIGHTS SHALL BE 
CONDUCTED WITHIN A SPECIFIC TIME FRAME AND LIMITED IN SCOPE, TAKING 
INTO ACCOUNT THE ACTIVITIES OF BORDER UNITS IN THE REGION AND THE 
FLIGHT PLANS FOR SUB-CLOUD UAVS, AND COORDINATION MUST BE MAINTAINED 
WITH ENTITIES USING THE AIRSPACE IN THE REGION,
C. THERE IS A NEED TO PRIORITIZE MILITARY ACTIVITIES IN THE REGION 
AND, IF NECESSARY, TO CANCEL OR TEMPORARILY SUSPEND SUCH ACTIVITIES,
D. PLANNING SHALL BE CARRIED OUT IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE RESULTS OF 
THE COORDINATION TO BE ESTABLISHED WITH THE UNITS UNDER THE COMMAND 
OF THE AIR FORCE COMMAND WHOSE CONTACT NUMBERS ARE PROVIDED BELOW 
AND OTHER MILITARY UNITS IN THE REGION PRIOR TO THE ACTIVITIES.
- CONTACT:
 ERZURUM AIR FORCE REGIONAL COMMAND (0-442-263-3143/3144/3145 / EXT. 
4121/4122/4123/4124),
JOINT AIR OPERATIONS CENTER (JAOC)/JFAC COMMAND - ESKISEHIR 
(0-222-324-33-92).
REF SUP 05/26

 BE FOLLOWED IF PILOT REQUESTED AND UNDER HIS OWN DISCRETION.

MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION.
GREEK AIR OPERATORS AND OWNERS OF ACFT REGISTERED IN GREECE SHALL 
NOT ENTER UIR KYIV (UKBU), FIR LVIV (UKLV), FIR KYIV (UKBV), FIR 
DNIPROPETROVSK (UKDV), FIR SIMFEROPOL (UKFV), FIR ODESA (UKOV), FIR 
ROSTOV (URRV), FIR CHISINAU (LUUU) EXCEPT FOR THE PORTION OF 
AIRSPACE DESCRIBED IN AND RELATED TO RELEVANT NOTAM AND AIP SUPS 
ISSUED BY REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA.
SAID OPERATORS AND ACFT OWNERS SHALL ALSO AVOID FLIGHT OPERATIONS 
WITHIN THE BUFFER ZONE EXTENDING OUT TO 200NM ALONG THE 
UKRAINE/RUSSIA BORDER.
ADDITIONAL RISK ASSESSMENT AND FLIGHT PLANNING DECISIONS SHALL BE 
TAKEN BEFORE OPERATING IN THE FOLLOWING AIRSPACE: MOSCOW (UUWV).

MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION:
ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT AND ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR 
OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE 
RUSSIAN FEDERATION ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, LAND IN, TAKE-OFF FROM, 
OR OVERFLY GREEK NATIONAL AIRSPACE, EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN, MEDEVAC AND 
SAR FLIGHTS, OR ANY OTHER FLIGHT, AS IN CASE OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR 
EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, BY PERMISSION OF THE GOVERNMENT OF THE 
HELLENIC REPUBLIC. ALL ACFT OPERATORS OF NON-SCHEDULED FLIGHTS 
BETWEEN RUSSIA AND GREECE, OPERATED DIRECTLY OR VIA A THIRD COUNTRY, 
SHALL NOTIFY ALL RELEVANT INFORMATION CONCERNING THE FLIGHT,
AT LEAST 48 HOURS IN ADVANCE TO HELLENIC CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY
CONTACT: FLIGHTPERMISSION(AT)HCAA.GOV.GR.

REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A3788/26 (261347 EUECYIYN AUG 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 191239 LTAAYNYX AUG 2026.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 250940 LGACYAYC AUG 2026.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A3788/26 (261347 EUECYIYN AUG 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER
(HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE
AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE AIR TRAFFIC IN THE AREA IS THE
HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH THE ATS AND ATC
UNITS.
MOREOVER, AS IT WAS NOTIFIED THROUGH THE REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION 
MESSAGE 250940 LGACYAYC AUG 2026, THE GREEK COMPETENT AUTHORITIES DID
NOT PROMULGATE A NOTAM IN RESPONSE TO REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST 
GIVEN THAT PART OF THE AREA REQUESTED OVERLAPS AREA OF NATIONAL
SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE. 
FOR ALL THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A3788/26 (261347 EUECYIYN AUG 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT
APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR.

properties.name: A3114/26 / LGTS
properties.originalText:
DUE TO SUMMER SEASONAL OPERATIONS IN LGTS AND MAKEDONIA TMA
REGULATIONS REGARDING TRAINING FLIGHTS ARE ISSUED AS FLW:
1. TOUCH AND GO ARE NOT ALLOWED AT THESSALONIKI AIRPORT.
2. IFR LOW APPROACHES ON RWY IN USE MAY BE ALLOWED BY ATC.
3. ONLY ONE (1) IFR TRAINING FLIGHT AT A TIME, EXECUTING INSTRUMENT 
APPROACH PROCEDURES (STAR/IAP/SID) WITHIN TMA, MAY BE ALLOWED, 
PROVIDING THREE (3) HOURS PRIOR APPROVAL BY ATC AND NO IMPACT ON ATC 
CAPACITY.
4. NIGHT VFR OPERATIONS ARE NOT ALLOWED.
5. VFR OVERFLIGHTS MAY AFFECT THE LATERAL LIMITS OF MAKEDONIA TMA, 
ONLY WITH PRIOR NOTICE AND NOT MORE THAN TWO (2) FLIGHTS AT A TIME.
6. LOCAL CIRCUIT FLIGHTS AT AIRFIELDS ARE EXCLUDED FORM THE ABOVE 
RESTRICTIONS.
7. OPERATIONAL/MILITARY/STATE AIRCRAFT ARE EXCLUDED FROM THE ABOVE 
RESTRICTIONS.

properties.originalText:
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
1. TURKIYE REQUESTED THE GREEK AIS TO PROMULGATE APPROPRIATE NOTAM 
FOR THE EXERCISE AREA LOCATED WITHIN INTERNATIONAL WATERS AND 
AIRSPACE OF AEGEAN SEA REGARDING THE TURKISH NAVY AND AIRFORCE A 
FIRING MILITARY EXERCISE (ASFAO) TO BE CONDUCTED  01 SEP 0500-28 OCT 
0900 UTC WITH 191239 LTAAYNYX SEP 2026.
2. GREEK AIS DID NOT PROMULGATE APPROPRIATE NOTAM FOR THE EXERCISE
AREA IN ACCORDANCE WITH OUR REF MESSAGE 191239 LTAAYNYX SEP 2026. 
UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES DUE TO THE INSISTENT ATTITUDE OF GREECE, 
TURKIYE IS LEFT WITH NO OTHER ALTERNATIVE BUT TO TAKE ITS OWN 
INITATIVE TO PROMULGATE THE NECESSARY NOTAM FOR THE EXERCISE AREA.
TURKIYE WILL TAKE NECESSARY MEASURES FOR THE SAFETY OF THE GENERAL
AIR TRAFFIC AS SHE DID IN THE PAST AND IS ALWAYS READY FOR 
COOPERATION AND COORDINATION IN THIS RESPECT.
3. EXERCISE AREA: 
A. LATERAL LIMITS:
384500N0252100E 384500N0245200E 381800N0245200E 381800N0252100E 
384500N0252100E
B. VERTICAL LIMITS: SFC-6000FT AMSL
C. DATE AND TIMES : SEP 01-03 07-10 14-17 21-24 0500-1200
                    SEP 28- OCT 01 0500-1200
                    OCT 05-08 12-15 19-22 0500-1200
                    OCT 26-27 0600-1300
                    OCT 28 0600-0900
4. PROCEDURES FOR EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
A. THE FLIGHTS WILL BE CONDUCTED AT VFR CONDITIONS AND UNDER 
POSITIVE RADAR CONTROL.
B. EXERCISE AIRCRAFT SHALL DISPLAY ANTI COLLISION AND NAVIGATION 
LIGHT CONTINUOUSLY.
   PROCEDURES FOR NON-EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
IN THE INTEREST OF FLYING SAFETY DURING THE EXERCISE, NON-EXERCISE
AIRCRAFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE EXERCISE AREA 
DESCRIBED ABOVE.

1.- AREA: 362900N 0280300E - 363300N 0282900E - 361408N 0284936E -

(RDS-IRBAX), G80 AND N128 (RDS-BANRO), N129 (PIROX-RDS), N136 
(RDS-SOTIV), RODOS TMA AFFECTED. 
- VERTICAL LIMITS: FL190-FL220. 
- DATES AND TIMES: OCT 02 04 06 08 10 12 14 16 18 20 22 24 1000-1500, 
26 28 30 1100-1600, NOV 02 04 06 08 10 12 14 16 18 20 1100-1600. 
2.- AREA: 361400N 0282944E - 361408N 0284936E - 355529N 0295918E - 
351800N 0300000E - 351700N 0293230E - 352920N 0280745E -

(NILAS-ALKIS), L995 (IRBAX-ULFIT), N128 (VAXOS-FOXLI), L52 
(LINRO-VAXOS), N134 (MASES-DOPUS), N129 (NAVOK-DOPUS), W54 AND Y661 
(ORVIS-ANTAR) AFFECTED. 
- VERTICAL LIMITS: FL170-FL220. 
- DATES AND TIMES: OCT 02 04 06 08 10 12 14 16 18 20 22 24 0900-1600, 
26 28 30 1000-1700, NOV 02 04 06 08 10 12 14 16 18 20 1000-1700.

3.1.- FLIGHT PLANS MUST BE SUBMITTED AND PERMISSION BY APPROPRIATE 
ATC UNIT MUST BE OBTAINED. 
3.2.- OUT OF TMAS, THE LIAISONS OF THE UNIT CONDUCTING THE 
ACTIVITIES SHALL ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH ATHINAI CONTROL. 
4.- PROCEDURES FOR NON EXERCISE AIRCRAFT: 
4.1.- IN THE INTEREST OF SAFETY DURING ACTIVITIES, NON EXERCISE AIRCRAFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE AREAS

BE AUTHORIZED TO ENTER THESE AREAS AFTER SPECIAL PERMISSION 
BY APPROPRIATE ATC UNIT.

properties.name: B2907/26 / ESNQ
properties.originalText:
PPR FOR ALL FLIGHTS WITHIN AND OUTSIDE AD OPERATING HOURS.
PPR-REQUESTS SHALL BE SUBMITTED KRN.PPR(AT)SWEDAVIA.SE AND MUST 
INCLUDE A VALID SANCTIONS CERTIFICATE. 
WWW.SWEDAVIA.NET/KIRUNA/ANSOK-OCH-BESTALL/ANSOK-OCH-BESTALL/SANKTIONS
CERTIFIKAT
PROCESSING TIME FOR PPR REQUESTS IS UP TO 36 HOURS AND IS PERFORMED 
DURING AD OPERATOR HOURS ONLY. FOLLOWING TFC IS EXEMPTED REGARDING 
PPR OUT OF SANCTIONS CERTIFICATE HOSP, STATE, SAR, SKED TFC, SWEDISH 
MIL AND OPERATORS WITH SIGNED SANCTIONS COMPLIANCE UNDERTAKING. 
OPERATORS SHALL ENSURE COMPLIANCE WITH ALL PUBLISHED PPR 
REQUIREMENTS AND OBTAIN PPR WHERE APPLICABLE.
FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH PPR REQUIREMENTS, INCLUDING SUBMISSION OF A 
VALID SANCTIONS CERTIFICATE, WILL RESULT IN THE AIRCRAFT BEING 
DIRECTED TO A SEPARATE STAND FOR VERIFICATION AND POSSIBLE POLICE 
NOTIFICATION UPON SUSPICION OF SANCTIONS BREACH. AN ADDITIONAL 
HANDLING CHARGE OF SEK 1,500 WILL APPLY. BY OPERATING THE AIRPORT 
THE OPERATOR AGREES THAT THIS CHARGE MAY BE APPLIED. AN INCIDENT 
REPORT WILL BE SUBMITTED TO THE SWEDISH CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY.

properties.originalText:
SPECIAL RESTRICTED AREA ESTABLISHED, THE RELEVANT REQUIREMENTS 
AS FOLLOWS: 
1. NAME AND IDENTIFICATION 
SPECIAL RESTRICTED AREA (ZB(SR)801) 
2. LATERAL LIMITS: A CIRCLE WITH A RADIUS OF 300KM CENTERED AT 
N395410E1162327, BEIJING PROHIBITED AREA (ZB(P)801) NOT INCLUDED. 
VERTICAL LIMITS: SFC-UNL 
EFFECTIVE TIME: H24 
3. SPECIAL RESTRICTIONS 
NO FLIGHT OPERATIONS SHALL BE PERMITTED EXCEPT COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS 
(NOTE 1), BUSINESS FLIGHTS (NOTE 2), AND FLIGHTS FOR MILITARY, 
CUSTOMS, POLICE SERVICES, AND FIRE-FIGHTING RESCUE PURPOSES. 
4. OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS 
4.1 MANNED AIRCRAFT SHALL BE EQUIPPED WITH A SECONDARY 
SURVEILLANCE RADAR (SSR) TRANSPONDER OR OTHER SURVEILLANCE 
EQUIPMENT OF EQUIVALENT PERFORMANCE, WHICH SHALL REMAIN ACTIVATED 
THROUGHOUT THE FLIGHT. UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SHALL HAVE RELIABLE 
SURVEILLANCE CAPABILITY, FITTED WITH AN AIRBORNE OPERATIONAL 
IDENTIFICATION TRANSMITTING MODULE, AN SSR TRANSPONDER OR 
SURVEILLANCE EQUIPMENT OF EQUIVALENT 
F)SFC G)UNL) 
// // PERFORMANCE, WHICH SHALL REMAIN ACTIVATED THROUGHOUT THE 
FLIGHT. 
4.2 PILOTS SHALL MAINTAIN CONTINUOUS TWO-WAY COMMUNICATION WITH 
AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL (ATC) UNIT. REMOTE PILOTS OF UNMANNED AIRCRAFT 
SYSTEM (UAS) SHALL HAVE RELIABLE MEANS FOR TWO-WAY COMMUNICATION 
WITH ATC UNIT. IN THE EVENT OF LOSS OF TWO-WAY COMMUNICATION, 
PILOTS OR REMOTE PILOTS OF UAS SHALL IMMEDIATELY SET THE SSR 
TRANSPONDER CODE FOR RADIO COMMUNICATION FAILURE, AND TAKE ALL 
FEASIBLE MEASURES TO OBTAIN ACKNOWLEDGEMENT FROM ATC UNIT. 
4.3 PRIOR TO ENTERING THE SPECIAL RESTRICTED AREA, AIRCRAFT MUST 
REPORT THEIR SECURITY STATUS (NOTE 3) TO THE ATC UNIT AND 
COOPERATE WITH AIRBORNE TARGET RECOGNITION. WHEN NECESSARY, 
AIRCRAFT WITHIN THE SPECIAL RESTRICTED AREA SHALL BE SUBJECT TO 
AIRBORNE SECURITY VERIFICATION. 
4.4 AIRCRAFT SHALL OPERATE STRICTLY IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE 
APPROVED FLIGHT PLAN. ANY INTENTION OR ACTION TO DEVIATE FROM THE 
FLIGHT PLAN MUST BE REPORTED TO ATC UNIT IN A 
F)SFC G)UNL) 
// // TIMELY MANNER AND APPROVED PRIOR TO EXECUTION. 
4.5 WHEN CIVIL AIRCRAFT OPERATES BELOW 3,000M (INCLUDED) ABOVE 
MEAN SEA LEVEL, THE INDICATED AIRSPEED (IAS) SHOULD NOT EXCEED 
450KMH. 
NOTE: 
1. CALIBRATION FLIGHTS, TEST FLIGHTS, FERRY FLIGHTS, AND 
PRODUCTION FLIGHT TESTS SHALL BE MANAGED IN THE SAME MANNER AS 
COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS. 
2. BUSINESS FLIGHTS REFER TO THOSE FLIGHT ACTIVITIES APPROVED 
UNDER RELEVANT PROVISIONS, AND OPERATED ON A NON-SCHEDULE BASIS 
WITH NO PASSENGER TICKET FOR THEIR BUSINESS OR ADMINISTRATIVE 
ACTIVITIES, ACCORDING TO THE SLOTS AND AIRPORTS OF DEPARTURE AND 
ARRIVAL SPECIFIED BY AN INDIVIDUAL USER. 
3. THE CONTENT OF SECURITY STATUS REPORT INCLUDES: AIRCRAFT 
IDENTIFICATION (FLIGHT NUMBER, OR AIRCRAFT NATIONALITY AND 
REGISTRATION MARK), SSR TRANSPONDER CODE, CURRENT POSITION, AND 
NORMALITY OF SECURITY STATUS.

PPR FOR ALL FLIGHTS WITHIN AND OUTSIDE AD OPERATING HOURS. 
PPR-REQUESTS SHALL BE SUBMITTED TO NUDRIFT(AT)SWEDAVIA.SE AND MUST 
INCLUDE A VALID SANCTIONS CERTIFICATE. PROCESSING TIME FOR PPR 
REQUESTS IS UP TO 36 HOURS AND IS PERFORMED DURING AD OPERATOR HOURS 
ONLY. TEMPLATE FOR SANCTIONS CERTIFICATE 
HTTPS://WWW.SWEDAVIA.NET/UMEA-AIRPORT/ANSOK-OCH-BESTALL/ANSOK-OCH-BES
TALL/SANKTIONSCERTIFIKAT/
FOLLOWING TFC IS EXEMPTED REGARDING PPR OUT OF SANCTIONS CERTIFICATE 
HOSP, STATE, SAR, SKED TFC, SWEDISH MIL AND OPERATORS WITH SIGNED 
SANCTIONS COMPLIANCE UNDERTAKING.
OPERATORS SHALL ENSURE COMPLIANCE WITH ALL PUBLISHED PPR 
REQUIREMENTS AND OBTAIN PPR WHERE APPLICABLE.
FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH PPR REQUIREMENTS, INCLUDING SUBMISSION OF A 
VALID SANCTIONS CERTIFICATE, WILL RESULT IN THE AIRCRAFT BEING 
DIRECTED TO A SEPARATE STAND FOR VERIFICATION AND POSSIBLE POLICE 
NOTIFICATION UPON SUSPICION OF SANCTIONS BREACH. AN ADDITIONAL 
HANDLING CHARGE OF SEK 1,500 WILL APPLY. BY OPERATING THE AIRPORT 
THE OPERATOR AGREES THAT THIS CHARGE MAY BE APPLIED. AN INCIDENT 
REPORT WILL BE SUBMITTED TO THE SWEDISH CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY.

properties.name: E2408/26 / LIBB
properties.originalText:
FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY IS REGULATED AS FLW: 
-AIRCRAFT NOT INVOLVED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS MUST NOT 
FLY OVER THE FIRE AREA AND MUST EXERCISE EXTREME CAUTION 
WHEN FLYING NEAR IT, CONSIDERING THE POSSIBLE INTERVENTION 
OF FIREFIGHTING ACFT. 
THEREFORE, WHEN AN AERIAL FIREFIGHTING OPERATION IS 
ANNOUNCED/ACTIVE, IT IS PROHIBITED TO FLY IN THE ZONES IDENTIFIED 
BY THE FIRE-FIGHTING AUTHORITIES AND NOTIFIED BY THE COMPETENT 
AUTHORITY OR, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS: 
I. WITHIN CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC 
COMMUNICATIONS ABOUT THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE FIREFIGHTING 
OPERATIONS FROM THE ENGAGED ACFT, BELOW 760M (2500FT) AGL 
WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 4KM 
(2 NM) FROM THE FIRE 
II. OUTSIDE CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, BELOW 900M (3000FT) AGL, 
WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 9KM 
(5NM) FROM THE FIRE. 
-TIMELY UPDATES REGARDING THE ZONES AND AREAS AFFECTED 
CAN BE BROADCAST ON GROUND/AIR/GROUND FREQUENCIES. 
-THE ENGAGED FIREFIGHTING AIRCRAFT KEEP THE ATS UNIT 
RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AFFECTED AREA INFORMED ABOUT THE 
FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS AND THEIR CONCLUSION. 
-THE ATS UNIT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE 
FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS PROVIDES AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES, AS FAR 
AS POSSIBLE: 
1.TO THE AIRCRAFT ENGAGED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS, EXCEPT 
IN THE FIREFIGHTING AREA WHERE IT PROVIDES ONLY FLIGHT INFORMATION 
AND ALERT SERVICES. 
RMK: IF A CTR IS AFFECTED BY THE FIRE, SID/STAR/INSTR APCH PROC COULD 
BE TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED OR MODIFIED 
2.TO OTHER GAT FLIGHTS, BASED ON THE INFORMATION AVAILABLE REGARDING 
THE FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY, WHICH MAY STILL BE INCOMPLETE. 
REF AIP ENR 1.1.1.4 'POLICE, CUSTOMS AND PATROL FLIGHTS ENGAGED IN 
URGENCY MISSIONS', PARAGRAPH C 'FIREFIGHTING'

properties.name: A1879/26 / LMMM
properties.originalText:
MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION.
ONGOING MILITARY ACTIVITY IN UKRAINE AND ALONG BORDER UKRAINE/RUSSIA 
AND USE OF A WIDE RANGE OF GROUND AND AIRBORNE WARFARE SYSTEMS WHICH 
POSES A HIGH RISK FOR CIVIL FLIGHTS OPERATING AT ALL ALTITUDES AND 
FLIGHT LEVELS. MALTESE REGISTERED AIR OPERATORS AND OWNERS OF 
AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN MALTA SHALL NOT ENTER UIR KYIV (UKBU), FIR 
LVIV (UKLV), FIR KYIV (UKBV), FIR DNIPROPETROVSK (UKDV), FIR 
SIMFEROPOL (UKFV), FIR ODESA (UKOV), FIR ROSTOV (URRV), FIR CHISINAU 
(LUUU) EXCEPT FOR THE PORTION OF AIRSPACE DESCRIBED IN NOTAMS AND 
RELATED AIP SUPPLIMENTS ISSUED BY THE REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA.OPERATIONS 
IN MINSK (UMMV) FIR ARE PROHIBITED UNDER EASA SD 2021-02 AND SD 
2021-03. 
OPERATORS ARE ADVISED TO FOLLOW ALSO RELEVANT CONFLICT ZONE 
INFORMATION BULLETIN (CZIB) ISSUED BY EASA AND AVOID FLIGHT 
OPERATIONS WITHIN THE BUFFER ZONE EXTENDING OUT TO 200NM ALONG THE 
UKRAINE/RUSSIA BORDER. ADDITIONAL RISK ASSESSMENT AND FLIGHT 
PLANNING DECISIONS SHALL BE TAKEN BEFORE OPERATING IN THE FOLLOWING 
AIRSPACE: MOSCOW (UUWV).

AKKUYU RESTRICED AREA IN ENR 5.1 
1. CLOSED TO ALL TRAFFIC (IFR/VFR) BELOW 11000 FT AMSL AND CLOSED TO 
ALL VFR TRAFFIC ABOVE 11000 FT AMSL AS WELL, EXCEPT: 
A ) AIRCRAFT OF THE PRESIDENCY OF THE REPUBLIC OF TURKIYE 
B ) FLIGHTS OF THE MINISTER OF ENERGY AND NATURAL RESOURCES 
C ) STATE AIRCRAFT OF THE REPUBLIC OF TURKIYE, AMBULANCE, FIRE 
FIGHTING, SEARCH AND RESCUE (SAR), AND EMERGENCY FLIGHTS 
D ) FLIGHTS APPROVED BY THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY AND NATURAL RESOURCES. 
2. FLIGHTS OF THE MINISTER OF ENERGY AND NATURAL RESOURCES, STATE 
AIRCRAFT REFERRED TO IN PARAGRAPH 1(C ), AND AMBULANCE, FIRE 
FIGHTING, SEARCH AND RESCUE (SAR), AND EMERGENCY FLIGHTS INTENDING 
TO USE THIS RESTRICTED AREA ARE REQUIRED TO INFORM THE COORDINATION 
POINT VIA +90 535 701 18 53. 
3. FLIGHTS OTHER THAN THOSE SPECIFIED IN PARAGRAPH 2 ARE REQUIRED TO 
OBTAIN PERMISSION FROM THE COORDINATION POINT VIA +90 535 701 18 53 
IN ORDER TO USE THIS RESTRICTED AREA. 
4. THE FLIGHT INFORMATION TO BE PROVIDED TO THE COORDINATION POINT 
IS AS FOLLOWS: CALL SIGN, DEPARTURE AERODROME, ESTIMATED TIME OF

NAME/ID.

INDICATE IN THE RMK/SECTION OF ITEM 18 OF THE FLIGHT PLAN THAT SUCH ) 
PERMISSION HAS BEEN OBTAINED, INCLUDING THE MEANS THROUGH WHICH THE 
PERMISSION WAS OBTAINED AND THE DATE AND TIME THEREOF. 
REF ENR 5.1-6

REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS A4350/26 AND A4351/26 (300903 AND 300938 
EUECYIYN SEP 2026). 
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED: 
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS 
A4350/26 AND A4351/26 (300903 AND 300938 EUECYIYN SEP 2026) ARE NULL 
AND VOID SINCE THEY REFER TO ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR, WHERE THE ONLY 
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE 
INTERNATIONAL RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE 
PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH THE HELLENIC ATS AND AIS UNITS. 
FURTHERMORE, THE ALLEGATIONS CONTAINED IN REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS 
A4350/26 AND A4351/26 (300903 AND 300938 EUECYIYN SEP 2026) ARE 
ERRONEOUS, MISLEADING AND DEVOID OF ANY LEGAL BASIS. 
WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF ITS WELL KNOWN AND LONG STANDING POSITIONS, 
WHICH ARE IN FULL COMPLIANCE WITH INTERNATIONAL LAW, GREECE WILL 
CONTINUE TO PLAN AND CONDUCT MILITARY EXERCISES IN THESE AREAS, AS 
IT HAS REGULARLY BEEN DOING ALL ALONG. 
CONSEQUENTLY, THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS A4350/26 AND A4351/26 
(300903 AND 300938 EUECYIYN SEP 2026) ARE NULL AND VOID AND NOT 
APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR. 
THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE NOTAMS WITHIN ATHINAI FIR ARE THE ABOVE 
REF (A) A3594/26 AND A3595/26 (300730 AND 300733 EUECYIYN SEP 2026) 
ISSUED BY GREECE. 
FINALLY, THE HELLENIC AUTHORITIES CATEGORICALLY REJECT THE ATTEMPT 
BY TURKEY TO INTRODUCE IN THE FLOW OF THE NOTAM ISSUING SYSTEM, 
POLITICALLY MOTIVATED STATEMENTS OF POSITIONS, WHICH, BESIDES BEING BASELESS, HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH THE FUNDAMENTAL PURPOSE OF THAT 
SYSTEM, NAMELY THE SAFETY OF AIR NAVIGATION. 
LIKEWISE, THE ABOVE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS A4350/26 AND A4351/26 USE 
FALSE NAMES TO DESIGNATE THE SPECIFIC GREEK ISLANDS INSTEAD OF THEIR 
INTERNATIONALLY KNOWN NAMES.

properties.originalText:
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED: 
 
THE NOTAM 'A3635/26' ISSUED BY GREEK CAA IN RESPONSE TO THE REQUEST 
OF TURKISH NAVY FOR THE UNMANNED ACFT FLIGHTS IS IRRELEVANT TO THE 
ORIGINAL TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST. 
 
THE NOTAM 'A3635/26' ITEM 2.2: 'UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SHALL NOT AFFECT 
HELLENIC NATIONAL AIRSPACE LESS THAN 10NM ACCORDING TO AIP-GREECE, 
ENR 1.1-1, PARA 1.1.1.2.1' AND ITEM 2.3: 'FLIGHT PLANS SHALL BE 
SUBMITTED ACCORDING TO ICAO ANNEX 2, APPENDIX 4, PARA 1.6 AND 
ACCORDING TO AIP-GREECE, ENR 1.10 AND GEN 1.7-1.' ARE IRRELEVANT 
AND NOT CONTAINED IN THE ORIGINAL NOTAM REQUEST MADE BY TURKIYE. 
FURTHERMORE THOSE STATEMENTS ARE IN CONTRAVENTION WITH ICAO RULES, 
CONTRADICT WITH THE INTERNATIONAL LAW AND CONSEQUENTLY VIOLATE THE 
RIGHT OF FREE USE OF INTERNATIONAL AIRSPACE. 
 
IT'S UNPRECEDENTED AND DEFIANT PRACTICE OF GREECE DEFINING 6NM WIDE 
TERRITORIAL WATERS AND 10NM NATIONAL AIRSPACE. ACCORDING TO 
INTERNATIONAL LAW THE AIRSPACE OVER WHICH A STATE CAN CLAIM 
COMPETENCE AND EXCLUSIVE SOVEREIGNTY IS LIMITED TO THAT PORTION 
WHICH LIES ABOVE ITS TERRITORY AND THE TERRITORIAL WATERS ADJACENT 
TO IT. 
 
TURKIYE REGRETFULLY DENIES AND DOES NOT ACCEPT THE ILLEGAL CLAIMS OF 
GREECE AND ITS MISUSE OF FIR RESPONSIBILITIES IN ORDER TO DEFEND ITS 
OWN UNBASED NATIONAL POSITION. TURKISH NAVY UNMANNED ACFTS WILL 
CONTINUE TO CONDUCT THEIR FLIGHTS RESPECTING THE 6NM GREEK AIRSPACE 
AND WITHOUT SUBMITTING ANY FLIGHT PLAN AS BEING MILITARY AIRCRAFT 
WHICH IS NOT SUBJECT TO 1944 CONVENTION ON INTERNATIONAL CIVIL 
AVIATION. TURKIYE WILL TAKE ALL NECESSSARY MEASURES FOR THE SAFETY 
OF THE GENERAL AIR TRAFFIC AND STAND BY FOR COOPERATION AND 
COORDINATION.

NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
FURTHER TO GREEK NOTAM A3697/26 (061219 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) ON TURKISH
NAVY AND AIRFORCE EXERCISE AND REFERRING TO TURKISH NOTAM A4506/26  
(070729 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) WE STATE THE FOLLOWING:
- THE ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS MENTIONED IN PARAGRAPHS 4.2 AND 4.3
OF THE GREEK NOTAM A3697/26 AIM AT:
1. THE PROMOTION OF SAFETY, REGULARITY AND EFFICIENCY OF
INTERNATIONAL AIR NAVIGATION AND THE AVOIDANCE OF INTERCEPTION OF
EXERCISE AIRCRAFT FOR IDENTIFICATION PURPOSES IN CONFORMITY WITH
ARTICLE 3 (D) OF THE ICAO CONVENTION ON INTERNATIONAL CIVIL AVIATION
AS AMPLIFIED BY THE A40-04 ICAO ASSEMBLY RESOLUTIONS, APPENDIX I,
RESOLVING  CLAUSE 2, SEE ALSO THE ANNEX 2 TO THE ICAO CONVENTION ON
INTERNATIONAL CIVIL AVIATION AS WELL AS ARTICLE 12 OF THE ICAO
CONVENTION AND THE ESTABLISHED INTERNATIONAL PRACTICE.
2. THE PREVENTION OF ANY MISUNDERSTANDING WITH REGARD TO THE WIDTH
OF THE NATIONAL AIRSPACE OF GREECE.
THEREFORE, TURKISH NOTAM A4506/26 (070729 EUECYIYN OCT 2026)
IS CONSIDERED NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/
HELLAS UIR.
THE ONLY VALID NOTAM FOR THE TURKISH NAVY AND AIRFORCE EXERCISE
WITHIN ATHINAI FIR IS THE ABOVE MENTIONED A3697/26 NOTAM ISSUED BY 
GREECE.

FURTHER TO GREEK NOTAM A3697/26 (061219 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) ON TURKISH
NAVY AND AIRFORCE EXERCISE AND REFERRING TO TURKISH NOTAM A4506/26  
(070729 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) WE STATE THE FOLLOWING:
- THE ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS MENTIONED IN PARAGRAPHS 4.2 AND 4.3
OF THE GREEK NOTAM A3697/26 AIM AT:
1. THE PROMOTION OF SAFETY, REGULARITY AND EFFICIENCY OF
INTERNATIONAL AIR NAVIGATION AND THE AVOIDANCE OF INTERCEPTION OF
EXERCISE AIRCRAFT FOR IDENTIFICATION PURPOSES IN CONFORMITY WITH
ARTICLE 3 (D) OF THE ICAO CONVENTION ON INTERNATIONAL CIVIL AVIATION
AS AMPLIFIED BY THE A40-04 ICAO ASSEMBLY RESOLUTIONS, APPENDIX I,
RESOLVING  CLAUSE 2, SEE ALSO THE ANNEX 2 TO THE ICAO CONVENTION ON
INTERNATIONAL CIVIL AVIATION AS WELL AS ARTICLE 12 OF THE ICAO
CONVENTION AND THE ESTABLISHED INTERNATIONAL PRACTICE.
2. THE PREVENTION OF ANY MISUNDERSTANDING WITH REGARD TO THE WIDTH
OF THE NATIONAL AIRSPACE OF GREECE.
THEREFORE, TURKISH NOTAM A4506/26 (070729 EUECYIYN OCT 2026)
IS CONSIDERED NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/
HELLAS UIR.
THE ONLY VALID NOTAM FOR THE TURKISH NAVY AND AIRFORCE EXERCISE
WITHIN ATHINAI FIR IS THE ABOVE MENTIONED A3697/26 NOTAM ISSUED BY 
GREECE.

properties.originalText:
LIMM AND LIRR FIR MAY BE AFFECTED, DUE TO AIR DISPLAY 
'III AERONAUTICA MILITARE BALLOON CUP', BY A MAXIMUM 
OF 16 (SIXTEEN) GAS BALLOONS. 
GAS BALLOONS WILL BE EQUIPPED AS FLW: 
1. TWO-WAY 8.33 MHZ VHF RADIO 
2. SSR TRANSPONDER MODE 'A' AND 'C' 
3. GPS 
4. STROBE AND BEAM LIGHTS 
5. SURVIVAL EQUIPMENT FOR OVERSEAS FLIGHTS 
6. EMERGENCY LOCATOR TRANSMITTER (ELT) 
7. SATELLITE GSM COMMUNICATIONS DEVICE 
REMARKS: 
ACTIVITY WILL BE CONDUCTED AS FLW: 
1. WITHIN ITALIAN AIRSPACE GAS BALLOONS SHALL 
APPLY VISUAL FLIGHT RULES ACCORDING TO THE CURRENT VERSION OF 
REGULATION (UE) NR. 923/2012 'SERA', AS APPLICABLE. 
2. IN ADDITION TO AND ACCORDING TO ENAC (ITALIAN CIVIL AVIATION 
AUTHORITY) REGULATION 'RULES OF THE AIR ITALY', FOLLOWING PROVISIONS 
ARE IN FORCE FOR NIGHT VFR OPERATIONS WITHIN ITALIAN AIRSPACE: 
A. PILOTS SHALL BE QUALIFIED TO CONDUCT NIGHT VFR ACTIVITY 
B. AIRCRAFT SHALL BE CERTIFIED FOR OPERATING NIGHT VFR BY OWN STATE 
OF REGISTRATION 
C. BELOW 3000FT AMSL / 1000FT AGL PILOTS SHALL MAINTAIN CONTINUOUS 
SIGHT OF THE SURFACE DURING THE FLIGHT 
D. FOR MOUNTAINOUS AREAS FLT VISIBILITY SHALL NOT BE LESS THAN 8KM 
E. SSR TRANSPONDER MODE 'A' AND 'C', DOUBLE COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT 
AND 'ELT' DEVICE ARE REQUIRED 
3. CONTINUOUS TWO-WAY RADIO CONTACT SHALL BE MAINTAINED WITH THE 
APPROPRIATE ATS UNIT. 
4. OPERATIONS CONDUCTED WITHIN AIRSPACES CLASSIFIED 'A', 'C', 'D', 
'E' AND IN THE AERODROME TRAFFIC ZONES (ATZ) OF CONTROLLED AIRPORTS 
SHALL BE AUTHORIZED BY THE APPROPRIATE ATS UNIT. 
5. IN CONTROLLED AIRSPACE ALTITUDE/LEVEL CHANGES SHALL BE AUTHORIZED BY THE APPROPRIATE ATS UNIT. 
6. GAS BALLOONS OPERATION SHALL NOT BE ALLOWED ABOVE FL090 WITHIN: 
- ZONE 7 MILANO TERMINAL CONTROL AREA (TMA) 
- CTA MILANO 6 'BUSSETO'- CTA MILANO 8 'EMILIA'- CTA MILANO 9 
'LIGURIA' 
7. GAS BALLOONS OPERATIONS SHALL NOT BE ALLOWED WITHIN: 
- ROMA TERMINAL CONTROL AREA (TMA) 
- ROMA AND FIRENZE CONTROL ZONE (CTR) 
- ROMA CONTROL AREA (CTA) CLASSIFIED 'A' 
8. DURING DAYTIME GAS BALLOONS OPERATION ARE STRICTLY FORBIDDEN 
WITHIN PADOVA CTA PORTION NORTH OF 440000N 
9. RESTRICTED (R) AND DANGER (D) AREAS, TSA (TEMPORARY SEGREGATED 
AREA) AND TRA (TEMPORARY RESERVED AREA) SHALL BE AVOIDED DURING TIME 
OF ACTIVATION UNLESS SPECIFIC AUTHORIZATION IS ISSUED BY THE 
RELEVANT ATS UNIT 
10.GAS BALLOON OPERATIONS SHALL NOT BE ALLOWED IF SSR TRANSPONDER 
INOPERATIVE 
11. ACT SUBJ PRIOR COOR WITH MILANO AND ROMA ITALIAN AIR FORCE 
COORDINATION AND CONTROL SERVICE (SCCAM) AND PADOVA/MILANO ACC 
12. DEPARTURE SITE: PIACENZA AD - LIMS 445447N0094324E

properties.originalText: FL..AIRSPACE WEST PALM BEACH, FLORIDA..TEMPORARY FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS. OCTOBER 17-18, 2026 LOCAL. THIS NOTAM REPLACES NOTAM 6/9386 DUE TO THE INCLUSION OF GATEWAY OPERATIONS. PURSUANT TO 49 USC 40103(B)(3), THE FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION (FAA) CLASSIFIES THE AIRSPACE DEFINED IN THIS NOTAM AS 'NTL DEFENSE AIRSPACE'. PILOTS WHO DO NOT ADHERE TO THE FOLLOWING PROC MAY BE INTERCEPTED, DETAINED AND INTERVIEWED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT/SECURITY PERSONNEL. ANY OF THE FOLLOWING ADDITIONAL ACTIONS MAY ALSO BE TAKEN AGAINST A PILOT WHO DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE RQMNTS OR ANY SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS OR PROC ANNOUNCED IN THIS NOTAM: A) THE FAA MAY TAKE ADMINISTRATIVE ACTION, INCLUDING IMPOSING CIVIL PENALTIES AND THE SUSPENSION OR REVOCATION OF AIRMEN CERTIFICATES; OR B) THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT MAY PURSUE CRIMINAL CHARGES, INCLUDING CHARGES UNDER 49 USC SECTION 46307; OR C) THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT MAY USE DEADLY FORCE AGAINST THE AIRBORNE ACFT, IF IT IS DETERMINED THAT THE ACFT POSES AN IMMINENT SECURITY THREAT. PURSUANT TO 14 CFR 91.141, ALL ACFT FLT OPS INCLUDING REMOTE CONTROLLED ACFT OPS ARE PROHIBITED: WI AN AREA DEFINED AS 30NM RADIUS OF 264047N0800327W (PBI094001.6) SFC-17999FT MSL; EXCLUDING AN AREA DEFINED AS 2NM RADIUS OF 261150N0801015W (FLL004007.4) SFC-17999FT MSL; EXCLUDING AN AREA DEFINED AS 2NM RADIUS OF 271054N0801317W (PBI349030.9) SFC-17999FT MSL EFFECTIVE 2610172030 UTC (1630 LOCAL 10/17/26) UNTIL 2610182345 UTC (1945 LOCAL 10/18/26). WI AN AREA DEFINED AS 10NM RADIUS OF 264047N0800327W (PBI094001.6) SFC-17999FT MSL EFFECTIVE 2610172030 UTC (1630 LOCAL 10/17/26) UNTIL 2610182345 UTC (1945 LOCAL 10/18/26). EXC AS SPECIFIED BLW AND/OR UNLESS AUTH BY ATC IN CONSULTATION WITH THE AIR TFC SECURITY COORDINATOR VIA THE DOMESTIC EVENTS NETWORK (DEN): A. ALL ACFT OPS WI THE 10NM RADIUS AREA(S) LISTED ABV, KNOWN AS THE INNER CORE(S), ARE PROHIBITED EXC FOR: APPROVED LAW ENFORCEMENT, MIL ACFT DIRECTLY SUPPORTING THE UNITED STATES SECRET SERVICE (USSS) AND THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES, APPROVED AIR AMBULANCE FLIGHTS, AND REGULARLY SCHEDULED COMMERCIAL PAX AND ALL-CARGO CARRIERS OPR UNDER ONE OF THE FOLLOWING TSA-APPROVED STANDARD SECURITY PROGRAMS/PROC AND ARE ARR INTO AND/OR DEP FM 14 CFR PART 139 AP: ACFT OPR STANDARD SECURITY PROGRAM (AOSSP), FULL ALL-CARGO ACFT OPR STANDARD SECURITY PROGRAM (FACAOSSP), MODEL SECURITY PROGRAM (MSP), TWELVE FIVE STANDARD SECURITY PROGRAM ALL CARGO (TFSSP-ALL CARGO), OR ALL-CARGO INTERNATIONAL SECURITY PROC (ACISP). ALL EMERGENCY/LIFE SAVING FLT (MEDICAL/LAW ENFORCEMENT/FIREFIGHTING) OPS MUST COORDINATE WITH ATC PRIOR TO THEIR DEP AT 561-275-1430 TO AVOID POTENTIAL DELAYS. B. FOR OPS WI THE AIRSPACE BTN THE 10NM RADIUS AND 30NM RADIUS AREA(S) LISTED ABV, KNOWN AS THE OUTER RING(S): ALL ACFT OPR WI THE OUTER RING(S) LISTED ABV ARE LIMITED TO ACFT ARR OR DEP LOCAL AIRFIELDS, AND WORKLOAD PERMITTING, ATC MAY AUTHORIZE TRANSIT OPS. ACFT MAY NOT LOITER. ALL ACFT MUST BE ON AN ACT IFR OR FILED VFR FLT PLAN WITH A DISCRETE CODE ASSIGNED BY AN AIR TFC CTL (ATC) FAC. ACFT MUST BE SQUAWKING THE DISCRETE CODE PRIOR TO DEP AND AT ALL TIMES WHILE IN THE TFR AND MUST REMAIN IN TWO-WAY RADIO COM WITH ATC. C. ALL FLIGHT OPERATIONS NOT COVERED IN PARAGRAPH A. WITHIN THE 10 NMR AREA MUST BE SECURITY SCREENED BY TSA AT A GATEWAY AIRPORT PRIOR TO ARRIVING OR DEPARTING PALM BEACH INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KDJT). AIRCRAFT OPERATORS MUST REGISTER WITH THE TSA FOR GATEWAY SCREENING NO LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THEIR SCHEDULED DEPARTURE TIME. RESERVATIONS FOR SCREENING MAY BEGIN ON 10/16/2026 AND LAST THROUGH THE DURATION OF THE EVENT BY CALLING TSA AT 407-563-6681, 561-227-5020 OR 904-380-9868. D. GATEWAY AIRPORTS HAVE BEEN CREATED AT PALM BEACH INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KDJT), ORLANDO INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KMCO), FORT LAUDERDALE INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KFLL), DULLES INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KIAD), TETERBORO AIRPORT (KTEB), AND WESTCHESTER CO. AIRPORT (KHPN) BY TSA TO ACCOMMODATE AIRCRAFT ARRIVING OR DEPARTING PALM BEACH INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KDJT). E. TSA SCREENING WILL NOT BE AVAILABLE 10/17/2026. TSA SCREENING WILL BE AVAILABLE 2610181200 UTC (0800 LOCAL 10/18/2026) TO 2610182100 UTC (1700 LOCAL 10/18/2026). PILOTS CREW AND PASSENGERS MUST PROVIDE VALID GOVERNMENT-ISSUED PHOTO IDENTIFICATION TO THE TSA AT THE GATEWAY AIRPORT. GATEWAY SCREENING WILL INCLUDE ID VERIFICATION AND VETTING OF ALL PILOTS, CREW AND PASSENGERS, SCREENING OF PERSONS AN BAGGAGE, AND INSPECTION OF THE AIRCRAFT. NO FIREARMS ON BOARD AIRCRAFT WILL BE AUTHORIZED. NO GIFT WRAPPED PACKAGES. F. ON DEPARTURE FROM A GATEWAY AIRPORT AIRCRAFT MUST MAINTAIN RADIO CONTACT WITH ATC AND CONTINUOUSLY SQUAWK AN ATC-ASSIGNED DISCRETE CODE. INTERMEDIATE STOPS WHILE ENROUTE ARE NOT AUTHORIZED. G. THE FOLLOWING OPS ARE NOT AUTH WI THIS TFR: FLT TRAINING, PRACTICE INSTRUMENT APCH, AEROBATIC FLT, GLIDER OPS, PARACHUTE OPS, ULTRALIGHT, HANG GLIDING, BALLOON OPS, AGRICULTURE/CROP DUSTING, ANIMAL POPULATION CTL FLT OPS, BANNER TOWING OPS, SIGHTSEEING OPS, MAINTENANCE TEST FLIGHTS, MODEL ACFT OPS, MODEL ROCKETRY, UNMANNED ACFT SYSTEMS (UAS), AND UTILITY AND PIPELINE SURVEY OPS. H. UAS OPR WHO DO NOT COMPLY WITH APPLICABLE AIRSPACE RESTRICTIONS ARE WARNED THAT PURSUANT TO 10 U.S.C. SECTION 130I AND 6 U.S.C. SECTION 124N, THE DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE (DOD), THE DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY (DHS) OR THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE (DOJ) MAY TAKE SECURITY ACTION THAT RESULTS IN THE INTERFERENCE, DISRUPTION, SEIZURE, DAMAGING, OR DESTRUCTION OF UNMANNED ACFT DEEMED TO POSE A CREDIBLE SAFETY OR SECURITY THREAT TO PROTECTED PERSONNEL, FAC, OR ASSETS. I. THE SYSTEM OPERATIONS SUPPORT CENTER (SOSC), IS THE CDN FAC FOR UAS OPS, SUBMIT SGI WAIVER REQUEST VIA HTTPS://WAIVERS.FAA.GOV, FIRST RESPONDERS EMGERGENCY OPS CTC THE SOSC AT 202-267-8276. J. THE FAA RECOMMENDS THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OPERATORS CHECK NOTAMS FREQUENTLY FOR POSSIBLE CHANGES TO THIS TFR PRIOR TO OPERATIONS WITHIN THIS REGION. OPERATORS MAY REVIEW THE TFR DETAILS ON THE INTERNET AT HTTPS://TFR.FAA.GOV/ OR HTTPS://WWW.1800WXBRIEF.COM. IF QUESTIONS REMAIN, CONTACT FLIGHT SERVICE AT 800-992-7433.

properties.name: A0429/26 / OKAC
properties.originalText:
DUE TO OPERATIONAL RESTRICTIONS WITHIN KUWAIT FIR ( OKAC ) : 
 
KUWAIT FIR IS AVAILABLE FOR FLIGHTS ARR OR DEP WITHIN KUWAIT FIR 
SUBJECT TO PRIOR APPROVAL FROM KUWAIT DGCA AIR TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT. 
 
OVERFLIGHT TFC OPERATING BTN BAHRAIN FIR ( OBBB ) 
AND BAGHDAD FIR ( ORBB ) VIA KUWAIT FIR ( OKAC ) 
IS PERMITTED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS VIA PUBLISHED ATS ROUTES 
FL 280 AND ABOVE SUBJECT TO PRIOR APPROVAL FROM KUWAIT DGCA AIR 
TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT, FLOW CONTROL MEASURES AND ATC CLEARANCE. 
 
ALL OTHER OVERFLIGHT OPERATIONS THROUGH KUWAIT FIR NOT PERMITTED. 
 
FLIGHTS DEPARTING FROM OR ARRIVING AT AIRPORTS WITHIN KUWAIT FIR 
TO/FROM BAGHDAD FIR ( ORBB ) ARE NOT PERMITTED. 
 
 
DEPARTING TFC FROM AIRPORTS WITHIN KUWAIT FIR 
SHALL USE THE FOLLOWING ROUTING : 
 
A.TFC DESTINED TO AIRPORTS WITHIN OBBB FIR OR OVERFLYING 
 OBBB FIR FOR DESTINATIONS OUTSIDE OBBB FIR SHALL FILE IN ACCORDANCE 
WITH THE NORMAL ROUTING ARRANGEMENTS BETWEEN OKAC AND OBBB FIRS AS 
APPLICABLE TO DESTINATION. 
 
B.TFC DESTINED TO AIRPORTS WITHEN JEDDAH FIR ( OEJD ) OR OVERFLYING 
JEDDAH FIR SHALL FILE VIA NIDAP L550 OR DEKOB P517 OR KATOD G667 OR 
ASVIR H741 AS APPROPRIATE TO DESTINATION. 
 
ARRIVING TFC AIRPORTS WITHIN KUWAIT FIR SHALL USE THE FOLLOWING ENTRY 
ROUTES: 
 
A.TFC ARRIVING FROM OBBB FIR SHALL FILE VIA KUMBO A453. 
 
B.TFC ARRIVING FROM OEJD FIR SHALL FILE VIA KUNRU P891 OR SOROR A788 
OR H741 ASVIR. 
 
OPERATORS SHALL CARRY SUFFICIENT FUEL TO ACCOMMODATE POSSIBLE DELAYS 
OR DIVERSION REQUIREMENTS DUE TO TACTICAL REASONS.

-EXTREME TURB BELOW 66FT AGL (157FT AMSL) WITHIN 9M

-ADVISE ATC (IF ATC ACTIVE)
-CIRCUIT OPERATIONS NOT AVBL 
-PRACTICE INSTRUMENT APPROACHES NOT AVBL

IMC, MIL ACFT CONDUCT IAP AT OWN RISK.
PLUME HAZARD OCCASIONALLY EXTENDS BEYOND THAT DEFINED ABOVE (EXPECTED
DURATION 2MIN) - ATC WILL ACTIVATE AND PROVIDE SEGREGATION TO
TERMINAL AIR TRAFFIC.
NO CONCURRENT CIVIL OPS WHILST ETC1 IS IN OPERATION WITHOUT PRIOR
APPROVAL.
ILS-Z AND LOC-Z RWY 15 NOT AVBL TO CIVILIAN ACFT DUE
HAZARDOUS PLUME INFRINGING INSTRUMENT APPROACH PROTECTION SERVICES.
ALL REQUESTS FOR CIVIL OPS DURING NOTAM PERIOD ARE TO CONTACT THE AIR
BASE OPERATIONS CENTRE ON TEL:(07) 5361 2888 OR AMB.ABOC

5362 8678 TO STOP OPS IF REQUIRED WITH 5MIN PN.

OPERATIONS WEST OF GOLDBERG STAGEFIELD (NORTH/SOUTH 48 GRID LINE) AND EAST OF HIGHWAY 231, INCLUDING THE AREA BETWEEN NOE BOXES 4D AND 5E/5F WILL UTILIZE THE FREQUENCY ASSOCIATED WITH NOE BOXES 3/4/5, EXCEPT AS REQUIRED FOR PUBLISHED CORRIDORS OR TRANSITIONS. ALL ARMY AIRCRAFT OPERATING OR TRANSITIONING THROUGH AO HAWK BELOW 2,500' MSL WILL MONITOR AND MAKE ADVISORY CALLS ON THE APPROPRIATE TRAINING AREA FREQUENCY 3KM PRIOR TO ENTRY. FOR AREAS WITHOUT DESIGNATED FREQUENCIES UTILIZE THE FOLLOWING: (1). OPERATIONS WEST OF GOLDBERG STAGEFIELD (NORTH/SOUTH 48 GRID LINE) AND EAST OF HIGHWAY 231, INCLUDING THE AREA BETWEEN NOE BOXES 4D AND 5E/5F WILL UTILIZE THE FREQUENCY ASSOCIATED WITH NOE BOXES 3/4/5, EXCEPT AS REQUIRED FOR PUBLISHED CORRIDORS OR TRANSITIONS. (2). OPERATIONS EAST OF GOLDBERG STAGEFIELD (NORTH/SOUTH 48 GRID LINE) WILL UTILIZE THE FREQUENCY ASSOCIATED WITH NOE BOX 6. (3). OPERATIONS NORTH OF NOE BOXES 3 AND 5 WILL UTILIZE THE FREQUENCY ASSOCIATED WITH NOE BOX 1. (4). SECURITY UNITED STATES OF AMERICA ADVISORY FOR POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS SITUATION IN THE JEDDAH FLIGHT INFORMATION REGION (OEJD) 

U.S. OPERATORS ARE ADVISED TO EXERCISE CAUTION WHEN OPERATING IN THE JEDDAH FLIGHT INFORMATION REGION (OEJD) DUE TO SAFETY-OF-FLIGHT RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH ONGOING MILITARY ACTIVITIES AND GNSS INTERFERENCE. THREATS COULD POSE A POTENTIAL RISK TO AIRCRAFT AT ALL ALTITUDES, INCLUDING DURING OVERFLIGHT, THE ARRIVAL, AND DEPARTURE PHASES OF FLIGHT.

THIS NOTAM APPLIES TO ALL U.S. AIR CARRIERS AND COMMERCIAL OPERATORS; ALL PERSONS EXERCISING THE PRIVILEGES OF AN AIRMAN CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY THE FAA, EXCEPT SUCH PERSONS OPERATING U.S.-REGISTERED AIRCRAFT FOR A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER; AND ALL OPERATORS OF CIVIL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN THE UNITED STATES, EXCEPT WHEN THE OPERATOR OF SUCH AIRCRAFT IS A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER. 

REPORT ANY SAFETY/SECURITY INCIDENTS OBSERVED/EXPERIENCED WHILE OPERATING IN THE AFFECTED AIRSPACE TO THE FAA'S WASHINGTON OPERATIONS CENTER AT 1(202) 267-3333.

UAS OPS MAY BE AUTH WI THE DEFINED AIRSPACE PROVIDED PRIOR APPROVAL HAS BEEN COORD WITH U.S. CUSTOMS AND BORDER PROTECTION (CBP), AND ALL APPLICABLE RQMNTS LISTED BLW ARE MET: 1. SECTION 130I AND 6 U.S.C.

ALL REQUESTS MUST INCLUDE:
1)	OPERATOR NAME 2)	FAA CERTIFICATIONS 3)	OPERATOR TELEPHONE NUMBER 4)	FLIGHT DATE, TIME AND LOCATION 5)	UAS INFORMATION: REMOTE ID, MAKE, MODEL AND SERIAL NUMBER.

D. FIRST RESPONDERS EMERGENCY UAS OPS CTC CBP AT 951-570-4185.

ANY PERSON WHO KNOWINGLY OR WILLFULLY VIOLATES THE RULES CONCERNING OPS IN THIS AIRSPACE MAY BE SUBJECT TO CERTAIN CRIMINAL PENALTIES UNDER 49 USC SECTION 46307. PILOTS WHO DO NOT ADHERE TO THE FOLLOWING PROC MAY BE INTERCEPTED, DETAINED AND INTERVIEWED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT/SECURITY PERSONNEL. PURSUANT TO 14 CFR 99.7, SPECIAL SECURITY INSTRUCTIONS (SSI), ALL UNMANNED ACFT SYSTEM (UAS) FLT OPS ARE PROHIBITED: WI AN AREA DEFINED AS 1NM RADIUS OF 362110N0864135W (BNA000012.9) SFC-400FT AGL EFFECTIVE 2608010001 UTC UNTIL 2708012359 UTC. EXC AS SPECIFIED BLW: A. UAS OPS MAY BE AUTH WI THE DEFINED SSI AIRSPACE IF IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE RQMNTS LISTED BLW: 1) UAS OPS IN DCT SUPPORT OF AN ACT NTL DEFENSE, HOMELAND SECURITY, LAW ENFORCEMENT, FIREFIGHTING, SAR, OR DISASTER RESPONSE MISSION; 2) UAS OPS IN SUPPORT OF EVENT OPS; 3) COMMERCIAL UAS OPS WITH A VALID STATEMENT OF WORK; 4) MUST BE IN POSSESSION OF AN APPROVED SPECIAL GOVERNMENTAL INTEREST(SGI) AIRSPACE WAIVER; 5) AND COMPLY WITH ALL OTHER APPLICABLE FEDERAL AVIATION REGULATIONS.

B. UAS OPR IDENTIFIED IN A.1, A.2 OR A.3 ABV MUST APPLY FOR A SGI WAIVER VIA HTTPS://WAIVERS.FAA.GOV.

C. U.S. OPERATORS ARE ADVISED TO EXERCISE CAUTION WHEN OPERATING IN THE OVERWATER AREAS ABOVE THE PACIFIC OCEAN AND THE GULF OF CALIFORNIA IN THE MEXICO FLIGHT INFORMATION REGION (MMFR) DUE TO MILITARY ACTIVITIES AND GNSS INTERFERENCE. POTENTIAL RISKS EXIST FOR AIRCRAFT AT ALL ALTITUDES, INCLUDING DURING OVERFLIGHT AND THE ARRIVAL AND DEPARTURE PHASES OF FLIGHT.

THIS NOTAM APPLIES TO ALL U.S. AIR CARRIERS AND COMMERCIAL OPERATORS; ALL PERSONS EXERCISING THE PRIVILEGES OF AN AIRMAN CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY THE FAA, EXCEPT SUCH PERSONS OPERATING U.S.-REGISTERED AIRCRAFT FOR A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER; AND ALL OPERATORS OF CIVIL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN THE UNITED STATES, EXCEPT WHEN THE OPERATOR OF SUCH AIRCRAFT IS A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER.

SECURITY UNITED STATES OF AMERICA PROHIBITION AGAINST CERTAIN FLIGHTS IN THE TERRITORY AND AIRSPACE OF HAITI.

THOSE PERSONS DESCRIBED IN PARAGRAPH A (APPLICABILITY) ARE PROHIBITED FM OPERATING AT ALTITUDES FM THE SFC-9999FT MSL IN THE TERRITORY AND AIRSPACE OF HAITI SOUTH OF 191000N AND NORTH OF 182000N BTN THE HAITI/DOMINICAN REPUBLIC BORDER AND 0730000W AND WI 17NM OF 191000N0723100W DUE TO SAFETY-OF-FLIGHT RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH ONGOING INSTABILITY.

A.	APPLICABILITY. THIS NOTAM APPLIES TO: ALL U.S. AIR CARRIERS AND COMMERCIAL OPERATORS; ALL PERSONS EXERCISING THE PRIVILEGES OF AN AIRMAN CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY THE FAA, EXCEPT SUCH PERSONS OPERATING U.S.-REGISTERED AIRCRAFT FOR A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER; AND ALL OPERATORS OF CIVIL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN THE UNITED STATES, EXCEPT WHEN THE OPERATOR OF SUCH AIRCRAFT IS A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER.

B.	PERMITTED OPERATIONS. OVERFLIGHTS ABOVE 10000FT MSL AND OPERATIONS IN THE TERRITORY AND AIRSPACE OF HAITI OUTSIDE OF THE ABOVE-NAMED AREAS DO NOT REQUIRE FAA AUTHORIZATION. THIS NOTAM DOES NOT PROHIBIT PERSONS DESCRIBED IN PARAGRAPH A (APPLICABILITY) ABOVE FROM CONDUCTING FLIGHT OPERATIONS IN THE ABOVE-NAMED AREAS WHEN SUCH OPERATIONS ARE AUTHORIZED EITHER BY ANOTHER AGENCY OF THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT WITH THE APPROVAL OF THE FAA OR BY A DEVIATION, EXEMPTION, OR OTHER AUTHORIZATION ISSUED BY THE FAA ADMINISTRATOR. OPERATORS MUST CALL THE FAA WASHINGTON OPERATIONS CENTER AT 202-267-3333 TO INITIATE COORDINATION FOR FAA AUTHORIZATION TO CONDUCT OPERATIONS. 

C.	EMERGENCY SITUATIONS. IN AN EMERGENCY REQUIRING IMMEDIATE DECISION AND ACTION FOR THE SAFETY OF THE FLIGHT, THE PILOT IN COMMAND OF AN AIRCRAFT MAY DEVIATE FROM THIS NOTAM TO THE EXTENT REQUIRED BY THAT EMERGENCY. THIS NOTAM IS AN EMERGENCY ORDER ISSUED UNDER 49 USC 40113(A), 44701(A)(5), AND 46105(C).

D.	IF AVAILABLE, ADDITIONAL INFORMATION CAN BE FOUND AT: HTTPS://WWW.FAA.GOV/ AIR_TRAFFIC/PUBLICATIONS/US_RESTRICTIONS/

properties.originalText: AERODROME BASH PHASE II IN EFFECT DURING THE BASH PHASE II PERIOD (1 OCTOBER - 31 JANUARY), AIRCRAFT WILL NOT BE SCHEDULED TO ARRIVE OR DEPART DURING THE BASH PHASE II WINDOW (1 HOUR PRIOR TO AND 1 HOUR AFTER SUNRISE AND SUNSET). DURING THE WINDOW, IF BWC IS LOW, ARRIVALS WHICH WERE SCHEDULED OUTSIDE OF THE WINDOW BUT ARE OPERATIONALLY PUSHED INTO THE WINDOW ARE AUTHORIZED ONE LANDING TO A FULL STOP WITHOUT A WAIVER. DEPARTURES WHICH WERE SCHEDULED OUTSIDE OF THE WINDOW BUT ARE DELAYED INTO THE WINDOW ARE AUTHORIZED TO DEPART WITHOUT A WAIVER IF BWC IS LOW. IF BWC IS MODERATE OR SEVERE, ALL AIRCRAFT MUST CONTACT IGUANA OPS TO OBTAIN 429 EOS/CC WAIVER APPROVAL WITH THE FOLLOWING EXCEPTIONS: EMERGENCY, LIFE FLIGHT/MEDEVAC, NON-CONTRACTED CIVILIAN AND FOREIGN AIRCRAFT; THESE AIRCRAFT DO NOT REQUIRE A WAIVER BUT WILL USE CAUTION AND OPERATE AT THEIR OWN RISK.

IF BWC IS MODERATE OR SEVERE, ALL AIRCRAFT MUST CONTACT IGUANA OPS TO OBTAIN 429 EOS/CC WAIVER APPROVAL WITH THE FOLLOWING EXCEPTIONS: EMERGENCY, LIFE FLIGHT/MEDEVAC, NON-CONTRACTED CIVILIAN AND FOREIGN AIRCRAFT; THESE AIRCRAFT DO NOT REQUIRE A WAIVER BUT WILL USE CAUTION AND OPERATE AT THEIR OWN RISK.

U.S. OPERATORS ARE ADVISED TO EXERCISE CAUTION WHEN OPERATING IN THE OVERWATER AREAS ABOVE THE PACIFIC OCEAN IN THE CENTRAL AMERICA FLIGHT INFORMATION REGION (MHCC) DUE TO MILITARY ACTIVITIES AND GNSS INTERFERENCE. POTENTIAL RISKS EXIST FOR AIRCRAFT AT ALL ALTITUDES, INCLUDING DURING OVERFLIGHT AND THE ARRIVAL AND DEPARTURE PHASES OF FLIGHT.

THIS NOTAM APPLIES TO ALL U.S. AIR CARRIERS AND COMMERCIAL OPERATORS; ALL PERSONS EXERCISING THE PRIVILEGES OF AN AIRMAN CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY THE FAA, EXCEPT SUCH PERSONS OPERATING U.S.-REGISTERED AIRCRAFT FOR A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER; AND ALL OPERATORS OF CIVIL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN THE UNITED STATES, EXCEPT WHEN THE OPERATOR OF SUCH AIRCRAFT IS A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER.

FL..AIRSPACE WEST PALM BEACH, FLORIDA..TEMPORARY FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS. OCTOBER 17-18, 2026 LOCAL. THIS NOTAM REPLACES NOTAM 6/9386 DUE TO THE INCLUSION OF GATEWAY OPERATIONS. PURSUANT TO 49 USC 40103(B)(3), THE FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION (FAA) CLASSIFIES THE AIRSPACE DEFINED IN THIS NOTAM AS 'NTL DEFENSE AIRSPACE'. PILOTS WHO DO NOT ADHERE TO THE FOLLOWING PROC MAY BE INTERCEPTED, DETAINED AND INTERVIEWED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT/SECURITY PERSONNEL. ANY OF THE FOLLOWING ADDITIONAL ACTIONS MAY ALSO BE TAKEN AGAINST A PILOT WHO DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE RQMNTS OR ANY SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS OR PROC ANNOUNCED IN THIS NOTAM: A) THE FAA MAY TAKE ADMINISTRATIVE ACTION, INCLUDING IMPOSING CIVIL PENALTIES AND THE SUSPENSION OR REVOCATION OF AIRMEN CERTIFICATES; OR B) THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT MAY PURSUE CRIMINAL CHARGES, INCLUDING CHARGES UNDER 49 USC SECTION 46307; OR C) THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT MAY USE DEADLY FORCE AGAINST THE AIRBORNE ACFT, IF IT IS DETERMINED THAT THE ACFT POSES AN IMMINENT SECURITY THREAT. PURSUANT TO 14 CFR 91.141, ALL ACFT FLT OPS INCLUDING REMOTE CONTROLLED ACFT OPS ARE PROHIBITED: WI AN AREA DEFINED AS 30NM RADIUS OF 264047N0800327W (PBI094001.6) SFC-17999FT MSL; EXCLUDING AN AREA DEFINED AS 2NM RADIUS OF 261150N0801015W (FLL004007.4) SFC-17999FT MSL; EXCLUDING AN AREA DEFINED AS 2NM RADIUS OF 271054N0801317W (PBI349030.9) SFC-17999FT MSL EFFECTIVE 2610172030 UTC (1630 LOCAL 10/17/26) UNTIL 2610182345 UTC (1945 LOCAL 10/18/26). WI AN AREA DEFINED AS 10NM RADIUS OF 264047N0800327W (PBI094001.6) SFC-17999FT MSL EFFECTIVE 2610172030 UTC (1630 LOCAL 10/17/26) UNTIL 2610182345 UTC (1945 LOCAL 10/18/26). EXC AS SPECIFIED BLW AND/OR UNLESS AUTH BY ATC IN CONSULTATION WITH THE AIR TFC SECURITY COORDINATOR VIA THE DOMESTIC EVENTS NETWORK (DEN): A. ALL ACFT OPS WI THE 10NM RADIUS AREA(S) LISTED ABV, KNOWN AS THE INNER CORE(S), ARE PROHIBITED EXC FOR: APPROVED LAW ENFORCEMENT, MIL ACFT DIRECTLY SUPPORTING THE UNITED STATES SECRET SERVICE (USSS) AND THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES, APPROVED AIR AMBULANCE FLIGHTS, AND REGULARLY SCHEDULED COMMERCIAL PAX AND ALL-CARGO CARRIERS OPR UNDER ONE OF THE FOLLOWING TSA-APPROVED STANDARD SECURITY PROGRAMS/PROC AND ARE ARR INTO AND/OR DEP FM 14 CFR PART 139 AP: ACFT OPR STANDARD SECURITY PROGRAM (AOSSP), FULL ALL-CARGO ACFT OPR STANDARD SECURITY PROGRAM (FACAOSSP), MODEL SECURITY PROGRAM (MSP), TWELVE FIVE STANDARD SECURITY PROGRAM ALL CARGO (TFSSP-ALL CARGO), OR ALL-CARGO INTERNATIONAL SECURITY PROC (ACISP). ALL EMERGENCY/LIFE SAVING FLT (MEDICAL/LAW ENFORCEMENT/FIREFIGHTING) OPS MUST COORDINATE WITH ATC PRIOR TO THEIR DEP AT 561-275-1430 TO AVOID POTENTIAL DELAYS.

B. FOR OPS WI THE AIRSPACE BTN THE 10NM RADIUS AND 30NM RADIUS AREA(S) LISTED ABV, KNOWN AS THE OUTER RING(S): ALL ACFT OPR WI THE OUTER RING(S) LISTED ABV ARE LIMITED TO ACFT ARR OR DEP LOCAL AIRFIELDS, AND WORKLOAD PERMITTING, ATC MAY AUTHORIZE TRANSIT OPS. ACFT MAY NOT LOITER. ALL ACFT MUST BE ON AN ACT IFR OR FILED VFR FLT PLAN WITH A DISCRETE CODE ASSIGNED BY AN AIR TFC CTL (ATC) FAC. ACFT MUST BE SQUAWKING THE DISCRETE CODE PRIOR TO DEP AND AT ALL TIMES WHILE IN THE TFR AND MUST REMAIN IN TWO-WAY RADIO COM WITH ATC.

C. ALL FLIGHT OPERATIONS NOT COVERED IN PARAGRAPH A. WITHIN THE 10 NMR AREA MUST BE SECURITY SCREENED BY TSA AT A GATEWAY AIRPORT PRIOR TO ARRIVING OR DEPARTING PALM BEACH INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KDJT). AIRCRAFT OPERATORS MUST REGISTER WITH THE TSA FOR GATEWAY SCREENING NO LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THEIR SCHEDULED DEPARTURE TIME. RESERVATIONS FOR SCREENING MAY BEGIN ON 10/16/2026 AND LAST THROUGH THE DURATION OF THE EVENT BY CALLING TSA AT 407-563-6681, 561-227-5020 OR 904-380-9868.

D. GATEWAY AIRPORTS HAVE BEEN CREATED AT PALM BEACH INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KDJT), ORLANDO INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KMCO), FORT LAUDERDALE INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KFLL), DULLES INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KIAD), TETERBORO AIRPORT (KTEB), AND WESTCHESTER CO. AIRPORT (KHPN) BY TSA TO ACCOMMODATE AIRCRAFT ARRIVING OR DEPARTING PALM BEACH INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (KDJT).

E. TSA SCREENING WILL NOT BE AVAILABLE 10/17/2026. TSA SCREENING WILL BE AVAILABLE 2610181200 UTC (0800 LOCAL 10/18/2026) TO 2610182100 UTC (1700 LOCAL 10/18/2026). PILOTS CREW AND PASSENGERS MUST PROVIDE VALID GOVERNMENT-ISSUED PHOTO IDENTIFICATION TO THE TSA AT THE GATEWAY AIRPORT. GATEWAY SCREENING WILL INCLUDE ID VERIFICATION AND VETTING OF ALL PILOTS, CREW AND PASSENGERS, SCREENING OF PERSONS AN BAGGAGE, AND INSPECTION OF THE AIRCRAFT. NO FIREARMS ON BOARD AIRCRAFT WILL BE AUTHORIZED. NO GIFT WRAPPED PACKAGES.

F. ON DEPARTURE FROM A GATEWAY AIRPORT AIRCRAFT MUST MAINTAIN RADIO CONTACT WITH ATC AND CONTINUOUSLY SQUAWK AN ATC-ASSIGNED DISCRETE CODE. INTERMEDIATE STOPS WHILE ENROUTE ARE NOT AUTHORIZED.

G. THE FOLLOWING OPS ARE NOT AUTH WI THIS TFR: FLT TRAINING, PRACTICE INSTRUMENT APCH, AEROBATIC FLT, GLIDER OPS, PARACHUTE OPS, ULTRALIGHT, HANG GLIDING, BALLOON OPS, AGRICULTURE/CROP DUSTING, ANIMAL POPULATION CTL FLT OPS, BANNER TOWING OPS, SIGHTSEEING OPS, MAINTENANCE TEST FLIGHTS, MODEL ACFT OPS, MODEL ROCKETRY, UNMANNED ACFT SYSTEMS (UAS), AND UTILITY AND PIPELINE SURVEY OPS.

H. UAS OPR WHO DO NOT COMPLY WITH APPLICABLE AIRSPACE RESTRICTIONS ARE WARNED THAT PURSUANT TO 10 U.S.C.

SECTION 130I AND 6 U.S.C.

SECTION 124N, THE DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE (DOD), THE DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY (DHS) OR THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE (DOJ) MAY TAKE SECURITY ACTION THAT RESULTS IN THE INTERFERENCE, DISRUPTION, SEIZURE, DAMAGING, OR DESTRUCTION OF UNMANNED ACFT DEEMED TO POSE A CREDIBLE SAFETY OR SECURITY THREAT TO PROTECTED PERSONNEL, FAC, OR ASSETS.

I. THE SYSTEM OPERATIONS SUPPORT CENTER (SOSC), IS THE CDN FAC FOR UAS OPS, SUBMIT SGI WAIVER REQUEST VIA HTTPS://WAIVERS.FAA.GOV, FIRST RESPONDERS EMGERGENCY OPS CTC THE SOSC AT 202-267-8276.

J. THE FAA RECOMMENDS THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OPERATORS CHECK NOTAMS FREQUENTLY FOR POSSIBLE CHANGES TO THIS TFR PRIOR TO OPERATIONS WITHIN THIS REGION. OPERATORS MAY REVIEW THE TFR DETAILS ON THE INTERNET AT HTTPS://TFR.FAA.GOV/ OR HTTPS://WWW.1800WXBRIEF.COM. IF QUESTIONS REMAIN, CONTACT FLIGHT SERVICE AT 800-992-7433.

SECURITY ...UNITED STATES OF AMERICA ADVISORY FOR POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS SITUATION IN THE MAZATLAN OCEANIC FLIGHT INFORMATION REGION (MMFO)

U.S. OPERATORS ARE ADVISED TO EXERCISE CAUTION WHEN OPERATING IN THE MAZATLAN OCEANIC FLIGHT INFORMATION REGION (MMFO) DUE TO MILITARY ACTIVITIES AND GNSS INTERFERENCE. POTENTIAL RISK EXISTS FOR AIRCRAFT AT ALL ALTITUDES, INCLUDING DURING OVERFLIGHT AND THE ARRIVAL AND DEPARTURE PHASES OF FLIGHT.

THIS NOTAM APPLIES TO ALL U.S. AIR CARRIERS AND COMMERCIAL OPERATORS; ALL PERSONS EXERCISING THE PRIVILEGES OF AN AIRMAN CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY THE FAA, EXCEPT SUCH PERSONS OPERATING U.S.-REGISTERED AIRCRAFT FOR A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER; AND ALL OPERATORS OF CIVIL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN THE UNITED STATES, EXCEPT WHEN THE OPERATOR OF SUCH AIRCRAFT IS A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER.

REFER TO THE BACKGROUND INFORMATION NOTICE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION FOR U.S. CIVIL AVIATION OPERATIONS IN THE AFFECTED AIRSPACE AT HTTPS:// WWW.FAA.GOV/AIR_TRAFFIC/PUBLICATIONS/US_RESTRICTIONS.

REPORT ANY SAFETY/SECURITY INCIDENTS OBSERVED/EXPERIENCED WHILE OPERATING IN THE AFFECTED AIRSPACE TO THE FAA AT FAA'S WASHINGTON OPERATIONS CENTER AT 1 (202) 267-3333.
